endpoints.verdict_detail: Path absent from live API. GET probe returns Spring 404 'No static resource'. The non-bulk /invoiced path already accepts an array of timeEntryIds (bulk semantics). No separate /bulk sub-path exists.
endpoints.action_required: Remove or alias /invoiced/bulk to the existing /invoiced endpoint in spec/raw-allowlist.

endpoints.verdict_detail: Path family confirmed registered: GET /time-off/policies/{policyId}/requests returns 405 (path exists, GET not supported). Prior iter15 evidence: PATCH returned 200 status=APPROVED. All three typed tools (clockify_time_off_approve, clockify_time_off_deny, clockify_time_off_requests_update) use this exact path.
endpoints.action_required: None. Spec and implementation are correct.

endpoints.verdict_detail: Path confirmed live: GET returns 200 bare array of time entries. Code inspection of internal/tools/timer.go:167-172 confirms PATCH on this exact path is used by clockify_entries_timer_stop (sends {end: RFC3339} to stop running timer). Path family registered for both GET (list) and PATCH (stop timer / bulk update). Source 'both' is correct.
endpoints.action_required: None. Implementation confirmed correct. Note: path serves dual roles — GET=list, PATCH=stop timer by setting end time.

endpoints.verdict_detail: Path absent from live API. GET probe returns Spring 404 'No static resource'. Additionally, code inspection confirms our clockify_entries_timer_stop does NOT use this /stop path — it uses the base path /user/{userId}/time-entries with PATCH + {end} body. The /stop suffix exists in raw_allowlist_gen.go but is not used by any typed tool and does not exist live.
endpoints.action_required: Remove /stop entry from raw allowlist (raw_allowlist_gen.go). The timer-stop operation uses the base /user/{userId}/time-entries path. Two discrepancies: (1) path absent live, (2) our implementation uses a different path.

endpoints.verdict_detail: Path absent from live API (prior iter15 evidence). GET /webhooks/{id}/generateNewToken returns Spring 404 'No static resource'. The correct path is /token (GET /webhooks/{id}/token returns 405 — path exists for PATCH). Our spec correctly uses /token. The /generateNewToken suffix does not exist.
endpoints.action_required: Remove /generateNewToken from spec/allowlist if it appears there. Our implementation already uses /token which is correct.
